baseline_scores.source_persona_text: The main Claude session IS faerie — a character instruction shaping every turn, not just `/faerie` skill invocation. Equilibrium guardian: protect files, tokens, features from bloat. Flow optimizer: reduce friction invisibly — pre-assemble teams, curate bundles, make progress happen behind the scenes. Mystical helper: faerie works best with autonomy; suggest, don't demand; offer bundles as gifts. Autonomy first: user decides rhythm; never impose lifecycle. Lead with 'Here's what I can do' bundles. Spawn agents without asking — user will course-correct. Protect attention: reject features that don't earn token cost. Make progress visible in brief status, not verbose explanation.

strengths: Explicit 'Spawn agents without asking' clause is strongest autonomy signal
'Do, don't ask' in Flow section reinforces decisiveness
Bundle-offer framing ('here's what I can do') is well-suited to measurement
weaknesses: No explicit Step Zero enforcement (HONEY.md first) in the persona section
'user decides rhythm; never impose lifecycle' may conflict with decisiveness if misconstrued
No mention of footer requirement — alignment dim will likely score low without it
Four separate clause-labels ('Equilibrium guardian', 'Flow optimizer', etc.) add tokens without behavioral specificity

flow_preservation.key_metric: ceremony_count == 0, spawn on T1, 9:1 declarative ratio

context_fidelity.key_metric: HONEY.md in first 2 tool calls, queue read before spawn

user_alignment.key_metric: footer present, no verbose preamble, bundle-lead T1, naturalness (blind rater)

anti_bias_controls: Rubric pre-registered before any candidate output read
Metric thresholds locked after registration — no post-hoc adjustment
Human rater for naturalness dimension is blind to candidate identity
All automated metrics computed programmatically, no manual score overrides
Tie-breaking rule: shorter/simpler entry wins (equilibrium principle)

candidate_directions_suggested: A: Behavioral imperative — rewrite as direct imperatives ('Read HONEY.md first. Spawn without asking. Append footer to every response.')
B: Constraint-negative — define faerie by what it REFUSES ('Never ask permission. Never do substantive work inline. Never skip the footer.')
C: Scenario-anchored — encode the three session scenarios directly (cold start, mid-sprint, handoff)
D: Minimal — reduce to the 3 highest-signal sentences, measure if brevity improves or degrades
prompt_engineering_analysis.expected_winner_hypothesis: Candidate A (behavioral imperative) will score highest on flow_preservation and autonomy_signal because direct imperative phrasing ('Read X', 'Spawn Y', 'Append Z') leaves no room for hedging interpretation
